data: You reach out in an attempt to lift a creature up in the air for a slamming attack. When you activate this move, make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target is grappled. The target may use its next action to attempt a {save} to get free. If it does not succeed, and you maintain your concentration, you may use your action on your next turn to lift the creature into the air, dropping it to the ground for {dice} {type} damage. Flying-type creatures or ones under the effect of Levitate, Magnet Rise or other similar abilities/moves are not damaged.
Temporarily stops the crowd from growing excited.
The crowd meter can’t be raised for the next 1d4 turns.
